positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and build new features to support different components in ITCM messaging infrastructure with C++ and Ruby
•	Number of defects resolved exceeded commitment by 125% 
•	Write automatic tests using Ruby/cucumber framework
•	Decompose complex problems and collaborate with other teams to tackle problems effectively
•	Apply Agile/Scrum concepts to ensure a quality delivery
•	Engage in code reviews and other practices to increase productivity and code maintainability

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
●	Work with small team of developers in a 2 weeks Sprint Cycle to create a new web application on Amazon Web Service that can validate user's images which can be hosted on any website.
●	Design and implement new and complex algorithms using C# that receive URLs from client and return whether the image from those URLs are valid or not base on Amazon and Google ad image criteria.
●	Ensure quick response time by introducing thresholds and time-out to the algorithms.
●	Create unit tests for all the corner cases.
